data.display_address: Seven City JLT, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai
data.long_description:
Seven City JLT is a prominent mixed-use development by Seven Tides International, situated in Cluster Z of Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT), Dubai. This ambitious project encompasses residential apartments, retail spaces, and hospitality facilities, offering a comprehensive urban lifestyle.

Residential Units:

• The development features a diverse range of apartment configurations:
• Studios: Sizes range from approximately 384 to 420 square feet.
• One-bedroom apartments: Sizes between 739 and 904 square feet.
• Two-bedroom apartments: Approximately 958 to 1,098 square feet.
• Three-bedroom apartments: Sizes from 1,516 to 1,539 square feet.

Each unit is designed with modern aesthetics, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that provide panoramic views of the Dubai Marina skyline, Emirates Golf Course, and surrounding lakes. Apartments come with fully equipped kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and high-quality finishes.

Amenities and Facilities:

• Residents of Seven City JLT can enjoy a variety of amenities aimed at enhancing comfort and convenience:
• Multiple Infinity Swimming Pools: Offering expansive views and a luxurious swimming experience.
• Fully Equipped Gymnasium: State-of-the-art fitness facilities to cater to various workout routines.
• Health Club: Promoting wellness with modern equipment and services.
• Children’s Pool: A safe and fun environment for younger residents.
• Sky Gardens: Beautifully landscaped areas providing serene spaces for relaxation.

Retail Facilities: Approximately 150,000 square feet of retail space, including a hypermarket, boutiques, cafes, and restaurants, ensuring all daily necessities and leisure needs are met within the development.

Seven City JLT integrates luxury living with convenience, making it a sought-after destination for residents and investors alike in Dubai's dynamic real estate landscape..
